看看附近的超市、便利店、菜市场、餐饮、药店、医院和快递点是否方便到达，以及外卖能: Check whether nearby supermarkets, convenience stores, grocery markets, restaurants, pharmacies, hospitals, and package pickup points are easily accessible, and whether food delivery comes upstairs.
看看附近的超市、菜市场、餐饮、药店、医院和快递，以及外卖能否上楼。: Check nearby supermarkets, grocery markets, restaurants, pharmacies, hospitals, package pickup, and whether food delivery comes upstairs.
确认停车棚、充电桩、收费，以及雨天积水情况。: Check parking sheds, charging stations, fees, and rainwater accumulation.
确认墙纸、挂钩、钉子、改色、换窗帘及退租恢复要求。: Check rules on wallpaper, hooks, nails, repainting, changing curtains, and move-out restoration.
确认押几付几、月付/季付/年付及押金金额。: Confirm deposit structure, payment frequency (monthly/quarterly/annual), and deposit amount.
确认数量、位置、书桌和小电器使用是否方便。: Check quantity, placement, and ease of use for desks and small appliances.
确认数量、运行、开门速度、维保情况及高峰拥挤程度。: Check elevator count, operation, door speed, maintenance status, and peak crowding.
确认是否允许、通知时间、流程、手续费及转租失败的押金处理。: Check sublet policy, notice period, process, fees, and deposit handling if subletting fails.
确认有无宽带、共享/独立、运营商、路由器位置及能否自装。: Check internet availability, shared vs. dedicated, provider, router location, and self-installation policy.
确认退房保洁要求、验收流程和入住前清洁约定。保洁收费统一记在费用中。: Check move-out cleaning standards, inspection process, and move-in cleaning terms. Record cleaning fees under Expenses.
确认通气、能否做饭、灶具类型、正常点火和火力，查看软管外观。: Check gas supply, cooking policy, stove type, ignition, flame strength, and hose condition.
